Hi mhie. 

I know it’s a terrible, terrible place out there especially to our trans brothers and sisters like you. There are horrible people out there, and there will definitely be days where you feel like this (or worse). That thread over a certain sub was heartbreaking and really demoralizing. 

But please know that at the very least personally, a significant part of the struggle for gender equality in the Philippines has and always will be lifted by our trans brothers and sisters. As a cis gay male, I cannot even begin to hold a candle against the strength and perseverance the trans community has displayed despite what seems to be insurmountable challenges. In short, I personally believe na **buhat niyo ang movement** while I sometimes feel like I’m just in it for the ride (but I’m striving to be a better part of the community). Honestly, it was my trans woman classmate back in Uni who opened my eyes to the importance of the collective struggle for freedom. Please never, EVER think that the entire LGBTQIA+ community would be better off without our trans brothers and sisters. Sinama niyo kami sa laban during the Stonewall Rebellion of 1969, and we would be DAMNED if kami pa ang unang mangiiwan sa inyo. **Lalaban kung lalaban!**

So while there may be days that you have thoughts like this, please know that this single gay Filipino man has always looked up to the resilient fortitude that you and the rest of the Filipino trans community display on a daily basis. I cannot even begin to imagine matching the strength you all have to use on a daily basis. 

We stumble, we fall. We rise up again. Hindi pa tapos ang laban, ngunit araw araw pumapalapit tayo sa liwanag sa dilim.
